rektion: etw. (Akk.) erlernen (einen Beruf, ein Handwerk, eine Sprache, ein Instrument)
meaning_en: to learn, to acquire (a skill, a trade), to train as
definition_de: etwas so lange lernen, bis man es wirklich beherrscht, besonders einen Beruf oder ein Handwerk (einen Beruf erlernen; eine Fremdsprache erlernen)
example_de: In einer kleinen Werkstatt erlernt mein Bruder seit einem Jahr den Beruf des Tischlers.
example_en: My brother has been training as a carpenter in a small workshop for a year.
visual_idea: Collocation 'einen Beruf / ein Handwerk erlernen': an apprentice at the workbench with the master watching shows learning a whole skill over time (not cramming facts like 'lernen'). Planing with long curls of shavings is a big, readable body action. Rejected: 'eine Sprache erlernen' (a person with a book reads as 'lesen') and 'ein Instrument erlernen' (reads as 'spielen').
image_prompt: a small bright carpentry workshop with tools hanging on the wall; a young apprentice in a dark work apron leans over a workbench and pushes a hand plane along a long wooden board, long curly wood shavings piling up; an older master carpenter with a grey beard stands right beside him, one hand on his shoulder, watching closely and nodding; sawdust glowing in the sunlight from the window
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: in a bright carpentry workshop a young apprentice slowly pushes a hand plane along a wooden board and long curls of wood shavings roll off; the grey-bearded master beside him watches, then nods and pats his shoulder; static camera
